organization.name: GoWorld Digital
organization.disclaimer: Proposed organizational model; this does not assert legal constitution, staffing or operational deployment.

layers.label: Governance
layers.purpose: Strategic direction, oversight, capital principles, risk and accountability.

units.label: Board of Administration
units.mandate: Define institutional purpose, long-term strategic direction, capital allocation principles, risk appetite and executive accountability.

units.label: Advisory / Strategic Council
units.mandate: Provide independent domain expertise, research critique, strategic challenge and ecosystem perspectives without executive or statutory authority.
units.note: Advisory rather than executive authority unless separately mandated.

layers.label: Executive Leadership
layers.purpose: Coordinate strategy, priorities, performance and operational authority.

units.label: CEO & Executive Direction
units.mandate: Translate board mandate into corporate strategy, operating priorities, portfolio resource allocation and executive accountability.

units.label: AI Operations / Ops Core
units.mandate: Intended coordination architecture for cross-unit missions, dependency tracking, human approval gates, budget evidence and operating rhythm.
units.note: Intended control plane, not the public Explorer and not assumed to be in production.

layers.label: Shared Services
layers.purpose: Transversal capabilities serving multiple business units.

units.label: Strategy & Intelligence
units.mandate: Conduct strategic analysis, market and competitive intelligence, geospatial/data synthesis and scenario planning for leadership and business units.

units.label: Finance & Administration
units.mandate: Manage financial control, budgeting, shared-service cost allocation, unit-economics reporting and administrative operations.

units.label: People & Agent Operations
units.mandate: Steward human talent, role design, upstream agent profile evaluation, capability lifecycle governance and human-in-the-loop operating standards.

units.label: AI Platform & Engineering
units.mandate: Architect and maintain shared software infrastructure, AI integration patterns, reliability engineering and automated quality verification.

units.label: Legal, Risk & Compliance
units.mandate: Oversee legal review, intellectual property and licensing provenance, regulatory compliance, contract governance and risk controls.

units.label: Marketing & Communications
units.mandate: Steward institutional brand narrative, public communications, editorial standards and shared demand-generation systems.

units.label: Product & Innovation
units.mandate: Guide product strategy, design systems, spatial/interactive user experience, prototyping standards and quality of experience across offerings.

units.label: Security & Data Governance
units.mandate: Enforce cybersecurity architecture, privacy protection, data access boundaries, auditability and operational assurance.

layers.label: Business Units
layers.purpose: Own customer outcomes, products, services and unit economics.

units.label: GWD Academy
units.mandate: Design and deliver executive education, applied AI training programs, learning communities, curricula and certification tracks.

units.label: GWD Media Factory & Growth
units.mandate: Produce digital media, interactive brand storytelling, multi-channel campaigns and measurable audience/revenue growth programs.

units.label: GWD Sales & Customer Operations
units.mandate: Run commercial pipeline operations, client onboarding, CRM workflows, service delivery coordination and customer success.

units.label: GWD Ventures & Venture Studio
units.mandate: Identify, validate and incubate new AI-native venture opportunities, strategic partnerships and potential spin-offs under stage-gated capital discipline.
units.note: Investment-centre candidate for portfolio exploration, not an established investment fund or operating spin-off.

units.label: AI Research & Systems Lab
units.mandate: Investigate applied AI systems, model evaluation benchmarks, reasoning reliability and foundational technical capabilities.

units.label: Agentic Architecture Lab
units.mandate: Experiment with multi-step workflow orchestration, bounded tool use, verification loops and human-approval gate protocols.

units.label: Data & Knowledge Lab
units.mandate: Explore structured knowledge graphs, provenance tracking, geospatial/domain datasets and retrieval quality.

units.label: Human-AI Interaction Lab
units.mandate: Prototype spatial interfaces, supervisory command environments, accessible 2D/3D visual grammars and collaborative human-agent workflows.

units.label: Venture Experimentation Lab
units.mandate: Run time-boxed problem discovery, market validation sprints and early prototypes prior to formal Venture Studio incubation.

relationships.rationale: Executive leadership is accountable to the Board of Administration for strategy execution, risk and capital stewardship.
Advisory / Strategic Council provides non-binding independent domain and research counsel to the Board.
AI Operations / Ops Core is a proposed coordination mechanism operating under executive direction and human sign-off.
Strategy & Intelligence reports to executive leadership as a transversal shared service.
Finance & Administration reports to executive leadership for financial control and governance.
People & Agent Operations reports to executive leadership for human talent and capability stewardship.
AI Platform & Engineering reports to executive leadership as shared technical infrastructure.
Legal, Risk & Compliance reports to executive leadership with escalation paths to governance.
Marketing & Communications reports to executive leadership for institutional brand and shared growth systems.
Product & Innovation reports to executive leadership for cross-portfolio product and UX standards.
Security & Data Governance reports to executive leadership for security architecture and data assurance.
GWD Academy is accountable to executive leadership for learning outcomes and candidate profit-centre performance.
GWD Media Factory & Growth is accountable to executive leadership for media production and growth programs.
GWD Sales & Customer Operations is accountable to executive leadership for commercial and customer outcomes.
GWD Ventures & Venture Studio reports to executive leadership on candidate investment-centre initiatives.
AI Research & Systems Lab operates under executive direction as a time-boxed research program.
Agentic Architecture Lab operates under executive direction for workflow and governance prototyping.
Data & Knowledge Lab operates under executive direction for provenance and knowledge-system research.
Human-AI Interaction Lab operates under executive direction for spatial and supervisory interface research.
Venture Experimentation Lab feeds validated problem/prototype hypotheses into GWD Ventures & Venture Studio.
Provides market demand analysis and curriculum positioning intelligence to GWD Academy.
Provides audience research and competitive intelligence to GWD Media Factory & Growth.
Provides cohort budgeting, pricing analysis and cost allocation tracking for GWD Academy.
Provides stage-gate capital accounting and milestone tracking for GWD Ventures & Venture Studio.
Supports instructor enablement and reviewed capability template stewardship for GWD Academy.
Supports role enablement and human-in-the-loop operational training for Sales & Customer Operations.
Delivers learning platform infrastructure, lab environments and technical QA for GWD Academy.
Delivers CRM integrations, workflow automation and reliability engineering for Sales & Customer Operations.
Provides brand governance, program communications and learner acquisition support for GWD Academy.
Aligns institutional brand standards and editorial governance with GWD Media Factory & Growth.
Provides learning experience design, curriculum UX and product discovery support to GWD Academy.
Provides prototype design and product validation frameworks to GWD Ventures & Venture Studio.
Provides IP review, regulatory screening and entity-structuring counsel to GWD Ventures & Venture Studio.
Enforces customer data privacy, consent governance and access controls in Sales & Customer Operations.

discrepancyNotes.topic: Layer 5 Labs count and naming between blueprint branches
discrepancyNotes.activeBranchModel: 5 Labs in blueprint/immersive-explorer-v1: AI Research & Systems Lab, Agentic Architecture Lab, Data & Knowledge Lab, Human-AI Interaction Lab, Venture Experimentation Lab.
discrepancyNotes.alternativeSeedModel: 3 Labs in blueprint/gwd-explorer-v1 (organization.seed.json): AI & Systems Lab, Organization Design Lab, Venture Lab.
discrepancyNotes.resolution: Preserved the 5 Labs documented in blueprint/immersive-explorer-v1 docs/ORGANIZATION_MODEL.md and organization-model.json. Organization Design Lab from the earlier seed overlaps with Human-AI Interaction Lab and People & Agent Operations; human governance decision is required on whether Organization Design Lab should be added as a 6th lab or folded into Human-AI Interaction Lab.
